notes.title: Update Patch
notes.content: Added new option to add support for other languages. Might add more in the future

notes.title: another small balance patch
notes.content:
-Party slightly more likely to flee first turn against slower/middling speed enemies
-NPC who sells smoke item now relocated to Romeo Village, will return to his original location after a certain point in the story (Bridge Crossing)
-Small graphical error fixed in desert
thanks

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.content:
fixed bug that prevented game from launching on windows 7 (for those who still use)
added consumable item to early game shops to slightly lower encounter rate, good for backtracking or exploring more dangerous areas

notes.title: Small balance patch
notes.content:
Some enemies are now easier to kill
Caster-type characters (Disciple/Wizard) have a small early game buff (they can now acquire their tier 2 equipment earlier)
Some extra items added to chests in the early game
Thank you so much to everyone who tried the game so far

notes.title: Sprint patch
notes.content:
Small QoL adjustment
Player can now sprint in most caves/dungeons and larger areas
